name: The Steed Stone
effect: +100 carry weight; equipped armor weighs nothing and does not slow you.

name: The Apprentice Stone
effect: Magicka regenerates 100% faster, but 100% weakness to magic.

name: The Atronach Stone
effect: +50 magicka and absorb 50% of spell magicka, but magicka regenerates 50% slower.

name: The Ritual Stone

name: The Serpent Stone
effect: Power: ranged paralysis for 5s plus 25 poison damage per second (once per day).

name: The Tower Stone
effect: Power: unlock one Expert-level or lower lock (once per day).
